purpose.zh: 练大腿和臀部，蹲下站起更轻松
purpose.en: Build your thighs and glutes for easier squatting and standing.

text.zh: 屁股往后坐，膝盖对着脚尖
text.en: Sit your hips back and keep your knees over your toes

text.zh: 脚跟一直踩地，胸口抬起。
text.en: Keep your heels down and your chest up.

text.zh: 蹲到大腿差不多和地面平，再推地站起。
text.en: Lower until your thighs are about level, then push through your feet to stand.

commonErrors.zh: 脚跟抬起，重心压到脚尖
commonErrors.en: Lifting the heels and shifting your weight onto your toes.

cautions.zh: 膝盖不舒服时蹲浅一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your knees feel uncomfortable, go less deep, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 口令按 0.9/0.8 s 缩短（往下坐/站起）
「臀部」改「屁股」更口语；cautions 改短句
节奏核对：动画顶点真正静止约 0.47 秒（<0.8），rep_hold 改为 rep_updown
flags: 派生把顶点算成 ≥0.8 s 判为 rep_hold，但 spec 轨道真正的静止只有约 0.5 s（注释/关键帧），若按实际应为 rep_updown，请确认
